Subject: Production run order & sponsor seating — Dec 7 webinar

Hello team,

We’re consolidating the final run order and sponsor seating layout for the Dec 7 live webinar (Acme / Redwood partnership). Goal is to lock technical handoffs and ownership today so we can run a single full dress on Dec 4. Summary below and asks at the end.

High-level run of show (first pass):
- 10:00 AM PT — Pre-show check (encoders connected, ON24 staging verified)
- 10:15 AM PT — Host intro (Redwood) + sponsor spot A (30s)
- 10:25 AM PT — Product demo (Redwood) + panel (15m)
- 10:45 AM PT — Live Q&A + sponsor spot B (30s)
- 11:00 AM PT — Close / recording release note

Sponsorship seating: Acme has two virtual sponsor seats in stage-right (priority camera & chat privileges). We need a confirmed seat map for ON24 to provision and for encoder routing.

Attachments: [Attachment: production_run_order_v1.csv (CSV)], [Attachment: sponsor_seating_map_v1.png (PNG)]

Asks:
1) ON24: please confirm the stage seat IDs and whether you need a separate RTMP stream for sponsor spot playback or if you’ll ingest via the main feed.
2) Ben: please attach the encoder mapping for the two sponsor feeds and confirm whether we can do a short prefix-cache warm-up before 10:00.
3) Priya / Acme: confirm sponsor creative lengths and if final assets will land by EOD tomorrow.
4) Legal / Laura: can you confirm the wording we’ll display for consent to recording and sponsor exposure? I’ve pasted a suggested blurb below.

Suggested registrant language (for ON24 banner & confirmation email):
"By registering you consent to being recorded during the live event. Recordings and sponsored materials may be shared with attendees and used by Acme and Redwood Inference for promotional purposes."

Thanks — want to get a clean sign-off today.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Event Program Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear run order. A few notes from platform operations: 

- Stage seat IDs: we will provision seat IDs SR-1 and SR-2 for the two Acme sponsor seats. Those map to ON24 stage slots and will have presenter audio/video enabled.
- RTMP: sponsor spot playback can be handled two ways:
  * Ingest via the main RTMP (single stream) and we trigger clip playback server-side — simpler but sponsor audio mixing is handled by ON24.
  * Provide a second RTMP (sponsor feed) so you can play pre-recorded creative locally and switch in. We recommend the second RTMP for guaranteed audio levels.
- Staging endpoints (short):
  * Primary: rtmp://staging.on24.net/redwood/primary
  * Sponsor: rtmp://staging.on24.net/redwood/sponsor
  * Backup: rtmp://staging.on24.net/redwood/backup

We can join a 30-min tech run tomorrow (Dec 1) at 10:00 AM PT. Please confirm whether you want ON24 to ingest sponsor clips or if Redwood will switch them from the sponsor encoder.

Regards,
The ON24 Production Desk
ON24
